---
title: "Apprentissage ojs avec tidytuesday"
format: dashboard
engine: knitr
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false

health_spending = FileAttachment("data/health_spending.csv")
  .csv()
  .then(data =>
    data.map(row => ({
      ...row, // permet de récupérer
      year: new Date(row.year),
      value: Number(row.value) // on pourrait écrire +row.value la conversion en nombre aussi
    }))
  )

 countries = Array.from(
  new Set(health_spending.map(d => d.country_name))
).sort()

types_unit = [
  {name: "% of current health expenditure", label: "En proportion de la dépense de santé totale"},
  {name: "constant 2023 US$", label: "En millions de dollars constants (2023)"},
]

```

# Table

```{ojs}
countries

Inputs.table(country_health_spending)
```

# Evolution

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}

viewof selected_country = Inputs.select(
  countries,
  {
    label: "Choisir un pays :",
    value: "France"
  }
)

viewof unite = Inputs.radio(types_unit, {
  label: "Unité à afficher en y :",
  format: x => x.label,
  value: types_unit[1]   
})

```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

country_health_spending = health_spending.filter(
  d => d.country_name === selected_country &&
    d.unit === unite.name
  )
  .map(
    row => ({
      ...row,
      value: row.unit === "constant 2023 US$" ? row.value / 1_000_000_000 : row.value
    })
  )
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

values = country_health_spending.map(row => row.value)
years = country_health_spending.map(row => row.year.getFullYear())

maxValue = Math.max(...values)
minValue = Math.min(...values)

maxYear = Math.max(...years)
minYear = Math.min(...years)
```

## Row (60%)

```{ojs}
evolution  = Plot.plot({
  title: "Dépenses de santé",
  subtitle: selected_country + " de " + minYear + " à " + maxYear,
  marginLeft: 50,
  x: {
    label: "Année"
  },
  y: {
    label: "En millions de dollars constants (2023)",
    type: unite.name === "constant 2023 US$" ? "linear" : "linear",
    domain: unite.name === "constant 2023 US$" ? [0, maxValue] : [0, 100],
    grid: true
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(country_health_spending,
      {
        x: "year",
        y: "value",
        fill : "expenditure_type",
        stroke: "expenditure_type"
      }
    ),
    Plot.lineY(country_health_spending,
    {
      x: "year",
      y: "value",
      stroke: "expenditure_type"
    }
  )
  ],
  color: {
      legend: true
  }
}
)
```
